derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are deliberately linked or jointly consumed by downstream reasoning, generation, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 12): During inference, the operative memory component (multi-modal 3D scene graph) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, merging or deduplication of overlapping entries; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
